verdict.rationale: A government agency that holds claimant and employer data could plausibly publish a policy or offer a control on whether that data is used for AI model training, so the privacy axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs, or any related privacy commitment. The items cover only unemployment tax procedures, EAMS filing, and probes of llms.txt, OpenAPI and robots.txt, which are unrelated.
